evidence.curator_note: adduct corrected to null: the precursor is an even-electron oxonium ion (charge +1, radical_electrons 0), not the [M]+. molecular ion. Equation 8.18, top row labelled 'heterolytic' (bond marked 'weak'): the generic even-electron oxonium ion R'(O+H)-R dissociates heterolytically with charge migration to give the neutral alcohol R'-OH and the alkyl cation R+ (McLafferty inductive cleavage, symbol i). Book draws 1 arc; move <1> is drawn -- a single full (double-barbed) curved arrow taking the O-R bonding pair onto oxygen, which neutralises the oxonium O+ (forming R'-OH) and expels R as a cation. No implicit hook is required: one two-electron arrow fully produces the products. GENERIC scheme: R'=CH3 and R=C2H5 are a curator-chosen instantiation (protonated methyl ethyl ether, C3H9O+); the book prints no specific structures, m/z, or intensities. Text: heterolysis at an EE+ site 'depends on the cation affinity of the leaving group, which on charge migration forms the neutral product' and is the lower-energy ('weak' bond) path.

NO MØD rule is cross-linked: rule_index.json by_equation['8.18'] is null (no IMS_8_18 variables exist). This generic heterolytic charge-migration bond dissociation at an EE+ site has no MØD Rule.fromDFS encoding in src/data_generation/rules/. rule_mismatches: none (nothing to compare against).
